fnol_text: My name is Elena Abernathy and I live at 54 Ashford Place, Fairview, PA 16474. You can reach me on (555) 730-5376 or elena.abernathy@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 16 November 2024 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2023-00062. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Abernathy on (555) 730-5376 to acknowledge the claim. Elena confirmed the loss date as 16 November 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Amara O'Connell gave a statement by phone.
Elena sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
